jobs.description:
**Location**

**Compensation**

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

  

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

As Headway’s SF Office Manager, and early member of the Workplace Experience Team, you’ll play a central and autonomous role in shaping the workplace experience for Headway employees. We’re looking for a gritty, operationally excellent, and relationship-obsessed team player to support Headway’s human hypergrowth and progress towards our mission. This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who thrives making independent, consequential decisions at the intersection of facilities operations & community in a dynamic, high-growth, and mission-driven environment.

**You will**
------------

* Own and independently manage SF office operations — exercise judgment on vendor selection, facility priorities, and resource allocation; serve as Headway’s authorized point of contact with building management, local vendors, and external partners
* Own the SF office budget — make spend decisions within approved parameters, identify and resolve budget variances, and proactively recommend operational efficiencies to leadership
* Exercise independent judgment in evaluating, onboarding, and holding vendors accountable to performance standards — negotiate day-to-day contract terms and escalate material issues with a recommended resolution
* Drive space utilization strategy — analyze usage patterns, determine layout and policy adjustments, and implement changes that optimize the SF workplace environment
* Design and own office communications and engagement — build the tools, channels, and rituals that keep SF employees informed and connected, exercising judgment on format, frequency, and content
* Lead planning and execution of in-person events and onsites — scope, resource, and deliver ~50 onsites/year in SF, including team gatherings, office-wide programming, and community moments
* Own SF office knowledge resources and playbooks — determine what gets built, maintained, and retired across Confluence pages, FAQs, and office guides
* Support office buildout and special projects — independently manage furniture upgrades, hackathon logistics, and ad hoc initiatives from scoping through completion
* In support of the above, you’ll also handle day-to-day operational needs including visitor registration, supply restocking, A/V setup, and reception

**You’d be a great fit if…**
----------------------------

* You have a minimum of 2 years of experience working in Community, Facilities, or Workplace Experience
* You are extremely skillful and passionate about Employee Experience and Facilities
* You have excellent communication and project management skills; you’re able to keep multiple workstreams running smoothly and visibly
* You love to build new things optimizing for scale, efficiency, and engagement
* You’re comfortable making independent decisions with limited oversight — whether that’s resolving a vendor dispute, reconfiguring the floor plan, or standing up a new office program from scratch

**Comprehensive benefits:**
---------------------------

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager, Sephora
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Tatcha is a skincare brand rooted in timeless Japanese wisdom, offering transformative yet kind-to-skin formulas that marry Japanese botanicals with clinical ingredients. Our formulation philosophy is informed by the Japanese concept hinou dokon, which means "skin-mind same root"—an acknowledgement of the powerful connection between the skin and the brain. Guided by the mission to care for people through their skin, Tatcha takes a holistic approach to skincare from concept to formulation to clinical evaluation, offering skincare rituals that benefit both skin and mind, while emphasizing the importance of mindfulness to skin health.

**Job Summary**  
The Assistant Account Manager will support the Senior Account Manager and Senior Director in the execution of retail sales strategies, manage key account relationships, and ensure flawless execution of product launches, promotional activities, and merchandising initiatives. This role is responsible for operational support and cross-functional coordination to drive business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Retail Strategy & Execution:

* Assist the team in developing and executing retail strategies that align with brand goals instore & online.
* Support the planning and implementation of promotional programs, product launches, and retail activations instore & online, including sku setup process.
* Manage the coordination of new product launches, working closely with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Education, etc) to ensure timely execution and robust 360 plans.
* Partner with internal and external teams to ensure alignment on sales and promotional initiatives including sampling and points opportunities.
* Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, ensuring that account-specific needs are met across the business.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date brand plans and communicate changes to necessary cross functional partners.
* Bring new ideas to the table

Retail Partner Support:

* Maintain day-to-day communication with key retail partners, supporting the team in fostering strong relationships.
* Support the creation of retailer presentations and marketing materials.
* Work with retail partners to ensure proper execution of promotional calendars, merchandising strategies, and inventory management instore & online.
* Coordinate with retail teams on product visibility and digital strategy to optimize both in-store and online sales channels.
* Support P&L management by owning billing and invoicing processes.
* Own internal creative process and timelines including PDPs and other marketing materials.
* Track and evaluate retailer promotional and sampling activities, providing feedback and recommendations for improvement.
* Gather market data, competitor insights, and industry trends to identify growth opportunities and areas for improvement to ensure that the brand remains competitive in the beauty marketplace.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2-3 years of experience in retail account management, preferably in the beauty or skincare industry. Experience working with Sephora highly preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with a focus on collaboration.
* Experience in financial analysis, sales forecasting, and budget management.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and retail analytics tools.

**The Details**

The expected base salary range for this position is $70,000 to $80,000. The exact base pay is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and budget.

This position is also eligible for participation in the company discretionary bonus plan based on personal performance and company results. Tatcha offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, disability insurance, retirement savings plans and company match, paid family leave, education-related programs, paid time off, and paid holidays. #LI-BH1

jobs.title: Customer Success Generalist
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.

**About the Role**

**Location:** New York City (Primary), Denver, Chicago, Singapore (APAC), London, San Francisco, Austin, Los Angeles  
**Commitment:** 5 Days In-Person

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers make progress and is willing to do the practical work between a question and a useful result.

As a Customer Success Generalist at Endex, you'll support onboarding, customer communications and adoption programs across the customer team. You'll take on changing needs as they surface, keep smaller projects moving and help the team turn recurring customer requests into a clearer operating process.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* **Support New Customers:** Prepare onboarding materials, coordinate sessions and follow up on open tasks with the account owner.
* **Investigate the First Blocker:** Gather useful context about a customer question, distinguish training from a product issue and route it with a clear next step.
* **Run Customer-Team Projects:** Coordinate onboarding preparation, targeted adoption outreach and follow-up from workshops or feature launches.
* **Maintain Customer Context:** Keep account notes, open issues and commitments accurate and accessible to the team.
* **Improve the Process:** Identify recurring requests and create practical documentation or workflows that reduce friction.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Customer Mindset:** You take a user's problem seriously and care about whether the answer helps.
* **Clear Writing:** You communicate accurately and can make an unfamiliar workflow easier to understand.
* **Practical Curiosity:** You learn tools quickly and investigate before escalating a question.
* **Strong Organization:** You keep track of details across accounts, requests and projects.
* **Flexible Follow-Through:** You can work across onboarding, support coordination and adoption programs while keeping account owners informed and commitments visible.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in customer success, support, consulting or implementation
* Comfort with Microsoft Office and enterprise productivity tools
* Experience documenting processes or running customer programs

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Health & Dental Insurance
* Monthly Wellness Stipend
* 401K Matching

jobs.title: Program Manager, Workplace Services
jobs.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What This Job Involves

As the Program Manager, you will lead the strategic evolution, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of front-of-house hospitality and physical logistics across the campus. In this role, you will bridge the gap between client leadership, vendor partners, and cross-functional teams to turn traditional reception desks and mailrooms into frictionless, user-centric, high-touch service hubs.

You bring a blend of hospitality mindset, analytical rigor, and process engineering to build scalable programs, set operational benchmarks, and deliver a welcoming first impression for every client and guest.

Program Oversight & Service Delivery

* **Program Ownership:** Define and execute the long-term vision, roadmap, and strategic goals for the Reception and Mail programs.
* **User Journey & Experience Design:** Map and continuously optimize the end-to-end guest and employee journey. Identify touchpoints to remove friction, enhance hospitality, and maintain a seamless experience.
* **Standard Operating Procedures:** Proactively develop, implement, and maintain unified SOPs for both the Reception (visitor management, security log audits, incident response) and Mail Room (routing, bulk mail processing, package room workflows) programs.
* **Process Improvement:** Shape and deploy a process-management mentality focused on driving efficiencies, cost-conscious resource optimization, and leveraging JLL best practices.
* **Training & Hospitality Standards:** Design, own, and manage the onboarding, hospitality service standards, and continuous development protocols for site teams executing Mail and Reception duties to ensure high-quality, hospitality-driven service delivery.
* **Quality Control & Compliance:** Verify the accuracy of visitor tracking, security badge protocols, and chain-of-custody mail logs. Conduct regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with health, safety, and site security requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Integration:** Partner with the Facilities team to align workplace services with broader site goals.

Client Relationships & Performance Management

* **Client Engagement:** Proactively manage relationships with the Client’s Program SMEs and senior executives, translating their business objectives into actionable program strategies.
* **KPI & SLA Compliance:** Monitor program performance using data-driven insights. Deeply understand and report on contract KPIs, analyze metric variances, and implement mitigation strategies to meet or exceed targets.
* **Reporting & Data Intelligence:** Develop, implement, and present a suite of management reports and metrics to the Client and account leadership, visualizing data to derive actionable intelligence.
* **Partner & Vendor Governance:** Collaborate closely with integrated facilities partners and external service providers to ensure vendor delivery meets client’s safety, security, and hospitality expectations.
* **Budget Support:** Support program budgeting, track capital and operational expenditures, and identify opportunities for scalable cost efficiency.

Qualifications

* **Experience:** Minimum 4- 6 years of leadership in high-touch, hospitality environments. Demonstrated expertise with VIP service standards and building white-glove service culture from the ground up.
* **Process Management:** Demonstrated success in process engineering or workflow optimization.
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong ability to extrapolate and visualize data to identify potential operational gaps and proactively formulate contingency plans.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Exceptional leadership and team-building skills with a track record of driving results through cross-functional teams without direct line-management authority.
* **Communication & Credibility:** High emotional intelligence with excellent presentation and negotiation skills; must be highly credible when interface-sharing with executive-level client personnel.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Familiarity with modern corporate site services, including advanced visitor management software, enterprise mail/package tracking platforms, and postal regulations.
* **Flexibility:** A future-forward mindset capable of balancing strict operational rigor with the speed, responsiveness, and flexibility required in a fast-paced corporate environment.
* **Education (Preferred):** Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management is preferred.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

95,600.00 – 125,770.00 USD per year

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.  
  
  

### **Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
* Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
* Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
* Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
* Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
* Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
* Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

Overview

**About Liquid AI**

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across every kind of hardware, from data center accelerators to on-device chips, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

**The Opportunity**

Our People team shapes how Liquid AI grows and how we look after our people, across the US and around the world.

We’re hiring a People Operations Manager to own our HR data and the operations that run on it, so every moment in someone’s time at Liquid AI is handled properly: their offer, their first day, a move to a new country, a visa, a pay review, their last day.

Behind every record is a person. Getting the details right is one of the most direct ways we look after our team, and you’ll make sure they’re right without needing to be chased.

You’ll report to our Head of People Operations and work closely with the engineers on our People team, testing and shaping the internal operating system they’re building. This is a hands-on operator role, not an HR business partner role.

This role will be based in our SF office, typically 4 days a week.

**What We’re Looking For**

We need someone who is:

* **Detail-oriented:** You notice when something doesn’t match, see how one change affects everything downstream, and fix it.
* **A team player:** You pitch in wherever the team needs you, and no task is too small.
* **Self-directed:** You get things done without much supervision, and you know when to escalate.
* **Someone who ships:** You work at pace, get through a high volume of work, and don’t let quality slip while you do it.
* **Someone who cares about people:** You see this work as part of how we look after our team, and you handle sensitive information with care.

**The Work**

* **Own our HR data:** keep HR, payroll and headcount records accurate and matching across systems, run regular checks, fix errors fast, and flag where they’re coming from
* **Handle onboarding and offboarding admin:** take care of the paperwork and system setup for every new starter and leaver, so their records are complete and correct from day one to their last
* **Manage employee changes:** process contractor conversions, moves between states or countries, contract amendments, salary changes, leaves and visa updates, so each one is touched once and done right in every system; for visas, work with our outside immigration counsel on documents and deadlines
* **Run benefits operations:** lead open enrollment, keep plan documents current and on hand, and work with our broker on renewals and compliance
* **Manage our people vendors:** be the day-to-day admin and escalation point for our HRIS, payroll, benefits and global EOR providers, and push open issues until they’re closed
* **Run comp analysis and offer letters:** benchmark roles against market data, model the full cost of offers and changes across countries, and prepare accurate offer letters consistent with approved terms
* **Help run cross-functional projects:** work with teams across the company on People projects, including our coworking weeks, which bring the team together several times a year
* **Test and shape our internal operating system:** be our main beta tester, running new features against real cases and working with the engineers until it’s right

**Experience & Capabilities**

What you’ll need:

* Experience in People Operations, HR operations or payroll, including time at an early-stage startup or on a small team where you covered a bit of everything
* Hands-on admin experience with a modern HRIS (Rippling, Workday, Deel or similar), owning the data and processing onboarding, offboarding and employee changes in it
* Experience with employees across multiple US states and countries
* Working knowledge of US benefits and compliance (open enrollment, ERISA, COBRA)
* Strong spreadsheet and analysis skills: comp benchmarks, cost models, headcount reporting, and the habit of checking your own numbers

Helpful, not required:

* A background in finance, accounting or payroll
* Experience with US immigration processes (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel
* Experience with comp benchmarking tools such as Pave or Carta

**What Success Looks Like (Year One)**

* HR, payroll and headcount records match across every system, with regular checks that catch errors before anyone else does
* Every employee change, benefits cycle and vendor issue is closed and tracked in one place
* Our internal operating system has a tight feedback loop with the operations work you do every day

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation & Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.
* **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.
* **Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.
* **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

**About OTTP-SF** (www.ottp-sf.org)

**Summary**

Under supervision of the Wraparound Program Manager, the Care Coordinator will provide care coordination services to youth involved in OTTP’s Behavioral Health Services Program. This role will primarily serve youth in the wraparound program, which provides individualized, strengths-based support to children and families with complex and enduring needs. The role is to support the client and family in identifying needs and lead a team of supporters in implementing a plan to support the client and family through facilitation of regular team meetings and provision of Intensive Care Coordination (ICC) and Intensive Home Based Services (IHBS).

**Essential Functions**

* Provide culturally-sensitive, clinically-informed Intensive Care Coordination (ICC) services to wraparound clients and families, under supervision and consistent with MHRS credentialing
* Facilitate Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings for wraparound clients and families, including preparation, coordinating attendance, facilitating meeting, and coordinating follow up action plan
* Collaborate with families, school staff, and community partners to identify and address child/family goals.
* Facilitate and/or participate in regular Wrap team provider meetings
* Collaborate effectively with internal team members and community partners, including but not limited to: therapists, psychiatric prescribers, county social workers, school staff, probation officers
* Provide case management and other support services to BHS clients, as needed
* Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation, including but not limited to: mental health notes, CFT notes, CANS assessment, CFT plans, and other required documentation, including documentation of justification for ICC and IHBS services
* Maintain accurate client charts and complete all clinical documentation according to SF County Behavioral Health standards, including utilization of Electronic Medical Record system to complete progress notes within 72 hours of service provision
* Follow guidance for meeting productivity standards as set by SF County Behavioral Health Services and the agency
* Provide clinical services appropriate to the MHRS credential, including but not limited to non-diagnostic mental health assessments, treatment planning, psychosocial rehabilitation/skill-building, etc.
* Participate in Wraparound-specific training and programming meetings with SF DPH and community stakeholders.
* Attend required agency meetings, trainings, weekly supervision and clinical meetings
* Participate in agency efforts to address, explore, and advocate to end racial & social injustice
* Maintain and uphold Agency mission statement, values, policies, procedures, and principles
* Perform other tasks and responsibilities as assigned by the Supervisor, Program Manager, and/or Director

**Minimum Qualifications** - Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

* Bachelor’s degree + 4 years experience working with children/youth and families with complex and enduring needs in a mental health setting OR Master’s degree
* Bilingual English & Spanish, preferred
* Strong collaboration and facilitation skills
* Strong ethical standards and professional integrity
* Good organizational skills
* Strong communication skills in written and verbal form
* Experience with electronic medical record systems (Epic) and Medi-Cal billing preferred
* Verification and background check required, including fingerprinting
* TB Clearance (every 4 years)
* Regular attendance
* Valid California Driver’s License and Car Insurance and regular access to transportation
* Maintain and uphold Agency mission statement, values, policies, procedures, and principles

**Supervisory Responsibilities**: No supervisory duties.

**Environmental Conditions:** (Working Conditions): This position entails working within various settings, including OTTP office, school settings, and the community.

**Physical Requirements:**

* This position entails sitting, standing, and walking.

jobs.title: Assistant Quality Manager

The Assistant Quality Manager is responsible for supporting the development and implementation of quality assurance and quality control processes to ensure construction projects meet established standards and client specifications. This role involves collaborating closely with project managers, engineers, contractors, and regulatory bodies to monitor construction activities, conduct inspections, and verify compliance with industry regulations and safety standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assists in developing and implementing quality management systems and processes to ensure compliance with industry standards and project requirements.
* Collaborates with project teams to establish quality objectives and oversees quality assurance activities.
* Conducts regular audits and assessments to identify areas for improvement and ensures adherence to quality standards.
* Manages and resolves quality issues in a timely and efficient manner.
* Prepares detailed quality reports and documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of industry regulations, standards, and best practices, ensuring all projects meet necessary compliance requirements.
* Coordinates with multiple departments, including project management and engineering, to support quality initiatives.
* Provides training and support to staff on quality assurance processes and procedures.
* Fosters strong relationships with clients, contractors, and regulatory bodies to ensure project success.
* Assists in preparing for audits by regulatory bodies and clients, ensuring all construction activities comply with legal and contractual requirements.
* Participates in team and Owner meetings; provides summary updates of status of the quality program.
* Mentors more junior staff.
* Other special projects as assigned.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED**

* Solid understanding of three phase QC.
* Strong understanding of Built-In Quality.
* Proven knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, tools, and standards (e.g., ISO, HCAI, DSA, NAVFAC/USACE CQM,).
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office and Quality Management software. Ability to learn new software quickly.
* Strong understanding of Jurisdictional process and compliance.
* Proven understanding of applicable codes, standards, and compliance requirements.
* Experience managing close out and commissioning of projects.

* Working level knowledge of decision quality and use of sound judgement.
* Working level customer focus and the ability to work cohesively with others.

**Position Title** Senior SF STEM Program Manager

**Location**: San Francisco, CA

**About SMART**

SMART (Schools, Mentoring and Resource Team, Inc.) champions education equity by supporting students in overcoming systemic barriers on their journey to a college degree. We envision a community with equitable pathways to college graduation for every student in San Francisco. SMART provides a unique twelve-year continuum of support that starts in 4th grade and extends through college, including school support, after-school enrichment, summer programming, college prep, and college persistence support. As a result, SMART Scholars are more than four times more likely to graduate college when compared to their peers. Furthermore, while only 21% of low-income students who enter college will graduate within six years, SMART Scholars are currently persisting at a rate of more than 80%.

SMART’s Values:

* Community: We build a community that celebrates diversity, thrives on teamwork, and appreciates everyone’s contributions. Through community, we are stronger.
* Equity: We are committed to systems and processes that are just, fair, and inclusive, enabling all people the opportunity to belong, participate, and reach their full potential.
* Empowerment: We believe the path to empowerment and self-advocacy is through the encouragement, support, and guidance of those around us.
* Learning: We believe education and life-long learning enhance our understanding of our world, our place within it, and provide the tools to change it. Through embracing challenges and learning opportunities, we make progress.
* Joy: We center joy in our community and practice. We view joy as an act of liberation, which unleashes creativity, strengthens relationships, and propels the work that we do.

**Position Description**

* Onboard new students and families into the program.

*Student and Family Advising and Activities*

* Support students in preparing and applying for after-school and summer STEM enrichment opportunities personalized to their interests.
* Plan and lead cohort meetings and events for students and families.
* In partnership with SMART staff, support 8th grade families in navigating high school application and enrollment processes.

*STEM Organization Partnerships*

* Cultivate and maintain partnerships with STEM organizations across the Bay Area and nationally to offer a variety of rigorous program options.
* Identify, match, and finalize each student’s after-school and summer program opportunities.
* With the support of the SMART Operations Manager, coordinate program logistics, including student transportation to the SMART office and to STEM opportunities outside of San Francisco.

*Data Tracking*

* Ensure student and program data is accurately and consistently collected and updated in SMART’s database.
* Use data collected to assess student needs and program effectiveness and to adjust the program model to achieve student and program goals.
* Collaborate with the Development Team to produce reports and talking points for the funder.

*Other Program and Organization-wide Responsibilities*

* Support and participate in organization-wide events as needed.
* Other duties and special projects as needed.

**Qualifications**

*Essential Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Strong passion for issues of educational equity for students from underserved communities.
* Deep understanding of the challenges faced by students from under-resourced backgrounds.
* Experience working directly with underrepresented communities is strongly desired.

**PROGRAM/LOCATION**: Markham Plaza (2000 Monterey Road, San Jose, CA 95112)

**SUPERVISOR**: Program Manager

**JOB TYPE**: Full Time, Non-Exempt

**ABOUT HOMEFIRST**

Established in 1980, HomeFirst™ is a nonprofit organization passionately working to end homelessness. We serve the Bay Area community through low-barrier programming and systems leadership – meeting each person where they are by offering support and resources that address immediate and long-term housing needs. With nearly 45 years of experience, we view housing as a fundamental human right and understand that solving homelessness requires a collaborative effort.

**OUR VALUES**

* ***Kindness****: We act with empathy toward others.*
* ***Passion****: We ignite change to fulfill our mission.*
* ***Excellence****: We deliver exceptional service to our communities.*

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

A Markham Plaza Case Manager is responsible for providing comprehensive support services to help individuals and families participating in permanent supportive housing programs. Their intensive and individualized case management services are coupled with linkage to a network of community resources to assist clients in averting homelessness, maintaining housing, and increasing self-sufficiency. To this end, the Housing Retention Case Manager participates in our collective effort to end and prevent homelessness.

This role reports to the Program Manager.

jobs.description:
**SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER CASE MANAGER**

**ROADMAP TO PEACE INITIATIVE, BEHAVIORAL HEALTH DEPARTMENT**

*Full-time, Union Position*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Program Summary:** The Roadmap To Peace (RTP) initiative is a collective impact program that advances economic, health and safety outcomes for Latino/a identified, disconnected youth ages 13-24, who are in-risk and/or violence involved. RTP is a collaboration of seven community based service providers and has three interrelated strategies: Healing through a culturally responsive service network, community building activities, and policy reform.

**Position Description:** The Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Case Manager is responsible for coordinating the SUD prevention and early intervention services within the RTP Initiative and providing service navigation, linkage and advocacy to clients. This role involves receiving referrals, conducting SUD screenings, providing SUD brief intervention services, and facilitating a minimum of six SUD harm reduction workshops annually. The Case Manager connects clients and/or their family members to both on- and off-site services, including employment, education and other resources. They provide ongoing case management to support client access to services, care coordination, and linkage to appropriate providers. This position carries a caseload of up to six youth at any given time and a total of eight youth throughout the year.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Conduct outreach activities to engage RTP youth in SUD services.
* Network and collaborate with schools, agency staff, probation/parole officers, and other partners to raise awareness of RTP initiatives and expand access to services.
* Conduct SUD screenings to determine client’s SUD risks and needs.
* Facilitate SUD Brief Intervention Services.
* Make referrals to partner organizations for clients in need of SUD treatment.
* Develop and facilitate a minimum of six SUD harm reduction workshops annually.
* Conduct client intakes and complete comprehensive case management assessments for all clients entering the caseload.
* Provide case management services to 8 clients per year.
* Facilitate referrals through effective interagency collaboration and networking.
* Maintain ongoing supportive services based on goals identified in the client’s case plan.
* Provide care coordination with internal/external partners to ensure wrap around support.
* Provide court advocacy, letters of support and resources to support youth’s legal needs.
* Actively participate in RTP-sponsored community activities, including day, evening and weekend trips when appropriate.
* Ensure all client documentation, case files, and service logs are current and compliant with agency and funder requirements, maintaining strict confidentiality.
* Complete all required reports, along with daily data entry and service tracking logs.
* Mandatory participation in the monthly service network meetings, RTP academy sessions and annual townhall and community hosted activities and/or events
* Support agency-wide efforts by participating in 1-2 community-wide and/or agency committees/collectives aligned with program and organizational values.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Behavioral Health Program Director.

**Experience and Qualification**

* Bilingual (Spanish/English).
* Bachelor’s Degree in Social Sciences and/or equivalent experience with at least two years of case management experience and SUD services experience.
* Adept in conducting intakes and case plan development and tracking.
* Able to conduct SUD screenings and provide Brief Intervention Services.
* Confident in developing and facilitating SUD harm reduction workshops.
* Must be detail oriented, deadline driven, and able to work independently and take initiative. Knowledge of youth service providers in San Francisco.
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, clinical interventions and approaches to youth development, behavior modification, restorative justice practices and harm reduction.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
**Join Us in Building the Future of Home Robotics**

At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 18 months building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

**What to Expect**

Sunday is putting robots into homes — around kids, pets, furniture, and families who haven't lived with a robot before. No regulatory body has defined what "safe" means for a home robot yet. We're defining it ourselves, and our brand depends on getting it right. You'll be our first product manager dedicated to trust and safety. You'll own the safety and privacy requirements for Memo end to end: what we test, what we promise users, and what we refuse to ship. You'll work across robot software, hardware, controls, ML, app, design, and operations to make safety a property of the whole system, not one team's checklist.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the safety and trust roadmap for Memo. Define what "safe enough to ship" means for each release, and hold the line on it.
* Build the system-level safety case. Map failure modes across navigation, hardware, controls, task design, firmware, and user communications, and make sure each has an owner, a test, and a mitigation.
* Work with engineering to define and track safety test coverage for every subsystem. Ensure firmware and software releases are validated against safety requirements before OTA.
* Own data privacy for the product: what Memo records in the home, who can see it (including teleoperators), how long it's kept, and how users understand and control it.
* Design how Memo behaves and communicates around kids, pets, and unexpected situations — stop conditions, warnings, recovery, and what the app tells users.
* Set standards where none exist. Draw on adjacent industries (consumer durables, home fitness equipment, new category products, appliances) to build a safety framework fit for a home robot — without importing process that doesn't apply.
* Run incident review. When something goes wrong in a home or the office, lead the investigation, root cause, and the change that follows.
* Partner with product operations to turn real-home observations into safety requirements.
* Define and track safety metrics: incidents per robot-hour, near-misses, test coverage by subsystem, time-to-mitigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years in product, safety, or quality roles on physical consumer products people touch and live with — think new category products, home fitness equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, or similar. You've shipped hardware into homes where the standards were thin and you had to set them.
* Not required: automotive, aerospace, or medical device background. While this is nice to have, we're looking for judgment in lightly regulated spaces, not fluency in pre-existing regulatory frameworks.
* Detail-oriented. You read the test report, not the summary. You notice the edge case nobody listed.
* Fast technical learner. You can pick up how a navigation stack, a controller, or a firmware release process works well enough to ask the right questions and spot gaps.
* Strong judgment and a deep sense of responsibility. You'll make calls that affect families, and you treat that seriously. You're comfortable being the person who says "not yet."
* Experience working with engineers on test plans, failure analysis, or release gating.
* Familiarity with data privacy principles for connected consumer devices (cameras, in-home sensors).
* Comfort with ambiguity at an early-stage company. You can write the first version of a safety standard that doesn't exist yet.
* Bonus: experience with consumer product safety standards (ASTM, UL, CPSC), in-home cameras or robots, or incident/recall processes.

**What success looks like in 6 months**

* Memo has a written, system-level safety framework with owners and test coverage for every subsystem, used as a release gate.
* Every firmware/software release passes a defined safety validation before OTA.
* Data privacy policy for in-home recording and teleop is defined, implemented in the app, and understandable to users.
* An incident review process is running, and beta learnings are feeding back into requirements.
* Product, hardware, and engineering leads treat the T&S PM as the owner of "is this safe to ship."

At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

This role helps ensure healthcare professionals and operational teams receive consistent, effective training across complex federal healthcare technology environments.

You'll lead the coordination of training schedules, instructor readiness, course delivery, and training quality across a geographically distributed user community. Working alongside clinical, technical, and program teams, you'll help strengthen training effectiveness, operational readiness, and the experience of healthcare technology users.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced training leader who enjoys managing complex learning operations, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and improving how large-scale training programs are delivered.

* Lead enterprise training operations across instructor-led, virtual, and self-paced learning programs.
* Own and coordinate high-volume enterprise training calendars, instructor assignments, and delivery schedules across multiple learning formats.
* Oversee instructor qualification, certification, train-the-trainer activities, and instructional readiness to maintain reliable training coverage.
* Lead coordination of course-development requests, quality reviews, feedback resolution, and training material releases with appropriate subject-matter experts.
* Manage training delivery changes and collaborate with program stakeholders to maintain quality, consistency, and alignment with customer requirements.
* Oversee training evaluations, course reporting, and continuing education accreditation compliance activities.

* Administering courses through Joint Knowledge Online (JKO).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Supporting military healthcare education programs or large-scale clinical technology training initiatives.
* Certified Professional in Training Management (CPTM), Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD, formerly CPLP), or a comparable professional training certification.

**Why Rackner?**

At Rackner, you'll work with teams delivering technology solutions that support important federal missions. We bring together technical, operational, and mission-focused professionals to solve complex challenges through collaboration and practical innovation.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute to a complex federal healthcare training environment, collaborate with experienced clinical and technical professionals, and help improve the consistency and effectiveness of training across a distributed user community.

Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms.

This is a remote position based in the United States. Candidates must hold an active Secret security clearance and be able to support the operational needs of a distributed federal healthcare training program.

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

**NOTE:** The essential functions are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Specific tasks or responsibilities will be documented as outlined by the incumbent's immediate manager.

High school diploma/GED is required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

* May be required to lift up to 20 pounds.
* Requires significant use of personal computer, phone and general office equipment.

* Needs ability to communicate effectively through reading, writing, and speaking in person or on telephone.
* May require off-site travel

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
None
  
  
DIRECTLY REPORTING
  
Reports to the Supervisor – Payment & Support Operations
  
  
TYPE OF SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
None
  
  
SCOPE AND COMPLEXITY
  
Works independently under general supervision, following defined standards and procedures. Reports to a Supervisor or Manger. jobs.title: Network Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

### **Proactive Client Improvement**

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

### **Leadership**

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

### **Education and Work Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ year

The role combines hands-on contract administration with responsibility for helping staff navigate legal intake and compliance processes, maintaining accurate records, and improving the systems that support this work. More than a traditional project manager, the Project Manager, Sponsorship & Experiential will own the execution of a high-priority initiative while also coordinating a variety of projects across the broader team as it matures into an enterprise-wide Center of Excellence. Work assignments will involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The ideal candidate is a natural orchestrator who loves bringing order to complexity. They can zoom out to understand strategic priorities, then zoom in to manage details that drive execution. They are comfortable leading without formal authority, building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and keeping multiple moving pieces on track simultaneously. They thrive at creating clarity, accountability, and momentum that help teams perform at their best.

: EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. **Job Summary**
---------------

Luminate Heritage is WellBe’s most technical in-house platform and supports changes across our EMR, scheduling platform and broader ecosystem. The Technical IT Project Manager is the long-term delivery owner for Heritage, accountable for turning architecture, engineering and operational dependencies into an executable roadmap. You will work credibly in code reviews, architecture sessions and SQL-based investigations; challenge scope and estimates; drive release readiness; and translate technical risk and tradeoffs into clear decisions for leadership.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Own delivery of the Luminate Heritage roadmap, including enhancements, technical debt, stabilization and modernization
* Work hands-on with developers and architects to decompose technical scope, review designs, validate estimates and sequence work
* Build and maintain a dependency map of Heritage's interfaces with Luminate 2.0, the scheduling platform and other systems, and assess the technical impact of every change
* Coordinate release engineering: branching strategy, CI/CD readiness, environments, code freezes, deployment windows, regression scope and rollback plans
* Investigate production issues with engineering, using logs, queries and monitoring to understand root cause and drive corrective action

* Ability to follow application code and technical designs, write and interpret SQL queries for data and defect investigation, and use logs or monitoring evidence to ask informed questions and validate engineering conclusions

* Experience managing shared platforms where one change affects multiple downstream applications

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Patient Experience - SaaS, Clinical Healthcare
jobs.description:
##### **About Sycle**

Sycle is a market-leading global SaaS company with the mission of facilitating the delivery of better hearing to the world. Founded in 2001, we have grown to be the leading practice management solution for audiology (hearing care) providers, with more than 65% market share. The Sycle practice management solution frees up valuable time so our customers can grow their businesses through delivering high-quality patient care and exceptional services that delight their customers. Small hearing care practices and some of the largest retailers use our software in 13 countries worldwide.

The Sycle team is 120 strong. We are headquartered in Lone Tree, Colorado, with a large remote workforce across the US and Canada. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to help us build and deliver market-leading tools that make a difference for our customers. This role is open to candidates based in **Greater Denver only**.

##### **The Opportunity**

Today, hearing care practices lose valuable time and revenue to manual paperwork, phone tag, and disconnected point solutions. As Senior Product Manager for Patient Experience, you will lead the multi-year vision to replace these fragmented touchpoints with a unified, modern patient journey.

You will manage a portfolio spanning six interconnected product areas:

* **Intake & Onboarding:** Pre-arrival digital forms, tablet/kiosk check-in, OCR/speech data capture, and e-signatures.
* **Patient Communications:** Bi-directional SMS, email, and voice messaging.
* **Patient Portal:** Self-service scheduling, payments, clinical documents, and intake forms.
* **Reviews & Surveys:** Automated NPS surveys, feedback collection, and online reputation management.
* **Marketing Automation & Growth:** Patient segmentation, acquisition campaigns, and lead nurturing.
* **Recalls & Retention:** Automated recall cadences for annual hearing exams, device warranties, and follow-up care.

You will leverage cutting-edge agentic AI workflows to accelerate research, product requirements, and prototyping while partnering across multiple squads to ship high-impact software.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Role Summary  
The Compliance Program Manager owns the full lifecycle of compliance frameworks across the  
organization, from regulatory monitoring and internal program readiness through to the  
productization and launch of new service offerings. This role is the single accountable owner  
for knowing what is changing in the regulatory and framework landscape, determining what the  
organization must do about it internally, and converting qualifying frameworks into repeatable,  
sellable, deliverable service lines.  
  
This is a hybrid compliance and product role. Approximately half the seat is program  
management: tracking framework requirements, owning internal compliance obligations,  
maintaining authorization and accreditation readiness, and driving remediation to closure. The  
other half is product management: business case development, scoping, methodology design,  
pricing input, enablement, and launch coordination for new offerings.  
The role is not a people management position but carries cross-functional accountability  
across PMO, TAC, Sales, RFP, Marketing, and Finance.  
  
Role Purpose  

* To ensure the organization is never surprised by a compliance change, never out of

compliance with the frameworks and authorizations it operates under, and never late to  
market with a new offering that the changing landscape creates demand for.  
  
Core Responsibilities  
  

* Compliance Program Ownership
* Own the organization-wide compliance framework calendar, tracking rule changes,

standard revisions, program updates, and authorization requirements across all  
frameworks the company operates under or delivers against  

* Maintain a current obligations register mapping each external requirement to an internal

owner, control, artifact, and evidence location  

* Drive internal readiness for new and renewing authorizations, accreditations, and

program approvals, including document production, gap closure, and submission  
coordination  

* Coordinate internal audits, surveillance activities, and external assessment cycles,

including scheduling, evidence collection, corrective action tracking, and closure  
verification

closure with defined owners and due dates

authorizations, delivery methodologies, or service eligibility, and issue timely impact

currency, and traceability

authoritative interpretation to delivery, sales, and leadership teams  

* Escalate impartiality, independence, conflict of interest, and eligibility questions to the

appropriate authority rather than resolving them unilaterally  
  
Productization and Offering Ownership  

* Evaluate emerging and revised frameworks for market opportunity, producing a written

business case covering demand signal, competitive landscape, required capability,  
margin profile, and go/no-go recommendation  

* Own the end-to-end productization of approved offerings, including scope definition,

deliverable set, methodology, work breakdown structure, level of effort model, and  
quality gates  

* Partner with Finance and Sales leadership to develop pricing, rate card entries, and

margin targets for new offerings

evidence requirements, and reporting formats

jobs.title: Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Do you want to support Vermont communities and listing officials? Do you want to ensure equity in property taxes? There has never been a better time to bring your values and talents to the collaborative team at the Vermont Department of Taxes. We are seeking a senior assessor to work closely with listers and assessors and to help lead the Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program (CALAP). If you have a passion for working with municipalities and a talent for managing programs, we want to hear from you!

  

The Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program, created by Act 163 of 2022, supports municipalities in appraising high-value commercial properties to establish fair and defensible values. This is one of two positions that supports this program. The CALAP Manager is responsible for the day-to-day aspects of the program, including but not limited to working with appraisal vendors and municipalities to ensure projects happen timely. This position will work closely with the PVR Division Director, the Field Director, other PVR division supervisors, department legal staff including the CALAP attorney, and external partners including municipal officials and appraisal vendors. They will also work closely with 10-15 municipalities, serving as their district advisor.

  

**Key responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:**

* Providing training, education, and support to municipal officials to maintain the statewide grand list for the purpose of education funding.
* Conducting detailed analyses of municipal assessment practices through the annual Equalization Study.
* Evaluating and updating utility valuation methodologies.
* Reviewing applications to the program.
* Coordinating with vendors to ensure timely completion of projects.
* Reviewing appraisals for accuracy and completion.
* Participating in the appeals process as needed.
  

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Experience in real estate appraisal or assessment, with some experience in reviewing appraisals especially for utility properties.
* Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Experience working with multiple vendors to ensure projects are completed timely.
* Some experience in reviewing appraisals especially for commercial properties.
* A desire to learn and grow and have experience fostering that desire in others.
* A proven record of prioritizing work, managing deadlines, and aligning expectations of internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of or willingness to learn about tax law and policies.
  

This is a full-time field-based position central to the southern portion or the northern portion of the State. Applicants will need to have reliable personal transportation to attend periodic meetings in the Montpelier main office and to conduct on-site visits with town officials generally in the Northern or Southern portions of the State. Click here to learn more about the technical and professional requirements of the CALAP Senior Assessor. For additional information about employee satisfaction and benefits, please see our website.

**About the Division of Property Valuation and Review**
-------------------------------------------------------

Property Valuation and Review (PVR) provides support to municipalities in developing and administrating property tax policies and related programs at the local level and has created an educational training and certification program that is available to municipal listers and assessors. PVR conducts annual ratio studies which estimate taxable property values and appraisals for school districts. It also administers the Use Value Appraisal Program (Current Use) which created almost $78 million in tax savings to landowners. PVR is currently implementing a new integrated property tax management system, and is planning modernization and digitization, making NOW the opportune time to join the team.

  

**Additional Information**
  
Compensation: The hourly salary rate for this position ranges from $33.53 to $52.55 and State of Vermont benefits are very competitive. The annualized salary for this potion ranges from approximately $69,742.40 to $109,304. The salary range reflects the minimum and maximum salary potential in the assigned pay grade, and the annualized salary figure is calculated based on 2080 hours of annual compensation and does not include authorized overtime or other compensation. It also doesn’t include any time taken off payroll. The starting salary for this position may be negotiable depending on experience and qualifications. This position is eligible for an office allowance and will be reimbursed for allowable business travel expenses.

  

**Background Checks:** This position will primarily support the Department of Taxes. Candidates must agree to be fingerprinted and pass a background check to be eligible for this position, which will involve access to sensitive federal tax information. Background checks are required by the Internal Revenue Service and are authorized under Vermont law. 3 V.S.A. § 241. In accordance with VDT Standard Operating Procedure 2018-01, Background Investigations, Vermont and national criminal record checks will be conducted on all candidates. Candidates will have the right to withdraw their application before fingerprinting or a background check is conducted.

  

We value diverse teams and are committed to creating a community of inclusion.

**Who May Apply**
-----------------

This position, **Commercial Appraisal and Litigation Assistance Program Manager (Job Requisition #56091)**, is open to all State employees and external applicants.

  

If you would like more information about this position, please contact Christie.Wright@vermont.gov.

Resumes will not be accepted via e-mail. You must apply online to be considered.

  

Please note that multiple positions in the same work location may be filled from this job posting.

jobs.title: US Account Manager (Part-time)
jobs.description:
Quix Sites builds and manages websites for small and growing businesses. Since 2018 we've done one thing: help business owners get found and chosen online.

We're a passionate team of 20+ experts and support over 500 small businesses owners.

You can learn more about Quix Sites here | https://www.quixsites.com/about/

----

**About the role**

We’re hiring a US-based account manager to join the sales calls that matter, then stay with the customer after they sign and ensure our customers achieve their goals.

We want someone who is great with people and understands small business, not someone looking to run a department or spend their nights chasing leads.

You don’t need to build websites. You do need to be comfortable talking about them, and you need to care about the business owner on the other side of the call.

----

**What you’ll do**

* Join calls with our US account executives. Be a warm, credible presence, help answer “who looks after me if I say yes?”, and help the owner feel confident moving forward.
* Become their named US account manager after they sign - a real person they can email or hop on a call with.
* Join kickoffs and the customer conversations that need a US presence, then work hand in hand with our project team, who design and build the sites from Australia and the Philippines, so the owner always knows someone in the States is in their corner.
* Check in at the moments that matter: after they sign, when they see their design, and around launch.
* Speak up early if a customer seems unsure or unhappy, so we can make it right.
* The project team handles the build. You handle the relationship. This is not a lead-generation, advertising, or website-development job, and you won’t be asked to manage a team.

----

**Who you are**

* You live in the United States, and you’re at ease on camera with small business owners.
* You’ve supported clients before - in account management, customer success, or another role where trust was the job - and you understand how personal it feels when someone’s business is on the line.
* You may have worked with website, design or marketing clients. You may have helped run a small business, or been close to someone who did. You know how to be professional without being stiff, and organised without making people feel like a ticket in a queue.
* You’re reliable. When we book a call, you’re there, prepared, and you follow through the same day.

----

**The practicalities**

* Part-time contractor, about 15–20 hours a week - not a full-time job in disguise
* Most of the work is live video calls during US business hours, plus follow-up in between
* Remote in the United States. Las Vegas is our first choice, so you’re close to Pacific hours; we’re also open to other US cities, especially in Pacific or Mountain time
* $35 an hour and 15-20 hours a week ($525 to $700 pw)
* You report to the CEO and work closely with our US account executives and project team
* A small bonus on deals you help close (but note this is not a commissioned sales role)

----

**How to apply**

* Apply with your resume and a short note (3–5 sentences) about your experience with small business owners, and where you are based.
* We can only consider people who live in the United States and can join live video calls during US business hours.

Pay: $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Experience in small business websites

Experience:

* Account Management: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
