jobs.title: Remote HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist (VA ESOM)
jobs.description:
Overview:

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring for a **HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist** to support the **VA ESOM** **contract**. The HAM Technical Field Implementation Specialist serves as a trusted advisor for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) field organizations as they transition to ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) as the enterprise system of record. The Specialist leads change management at the site level, training field staff on new processes, tools, and expectations while maintaining operational continuity.  
  
Kentro configured ServiceNow HAM for the VA, and this role is central to translating that configuration into consistent, policy-aligned practice in the field. The Specialist interprets VA asset management policy and directives, advises end users on compliant processes, and resolves complex and non-standard issues through root cause analysis and technical research, including issues involving device operating systems and how endpoint data is reflected in hardware asset records. The Specialist prioritizes incoming requests, tests and refines guidance to ensure end users receive accurate direction, and documents best practices that strengthen adoption and data quality across the enterprise.

**Location:** **Remote** - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

**Compensation Range:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000 –$120,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

Responsibilities:

Change Management and Adoption

* Lead site-level change management activities that prepare field staff to adopt ServiceNow HAM, including readiness assessments, targeted communications, and reinforcement of new processes.
* Identify adoption barriers and sources of resistance, and partner with the Change Management team to develop targeted interventions that sustain behavior change.
* Deliver training, coaching, and just-in-time support so field staff can independently navigate ServiceNow HAM, submit requests, and track status.
* Reinforce job aids, standard operating procedures, and training materials, and recommend updates based on field feedback and observed adoption trends.
* Monitor adoption indicators and field sentiment, escalating risks and recommending course corrections to program leadership.

Policy Interpretation and Compliance

* Interpret VA and federal asset management policies, directives, and procedures, and translate requirements into clear, actionable guidance for field staff.
* Ensure field practices and ServiceNow HAM usage align with applicable policy, identifying gaps and recommending corrective actions.
* Advise stakeholders on how policy applies to non-standard scenarios, documenting interpretations to promote consistency across sites.

Client Relationships and Field Engagement

* Build and sustain trusted relationships with VA field stakeholders.
* Select the most effective communication channel (e.g., chat, email, phone, or virtual meeting) based on issue urgency and stakeholder needs.
* Prioritize field requests, change management activities, and programmatic tasks based on urgency, operational impact, and site needs.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and provide proactive, timely updates through issue resolution.

Technical Issue Research and Resolution

* Conduct root cause analysis and investigative research to resolve standard and non-standard asset, inventory, and ServiceNow HAM issues.
* Apply working knowledge of device operating systems (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android) to diagnose issues with device identification and discovery, explain how endpoint data populates hardware asset records, and advise on operating system considerations that affect asset lifecycle decisions.
* Test, validate, and iterate on resolution approaches and end-user guidance within ServiceNow to confirm accuracy before broader dissemination.
* Escalate configuration defects and enhancement opportunities to the appropriate technical teams with clear supporting documentation.

Inventory and Asset Process Support

* Support field inventory activities and reconciliation in ServiceNow HAM across the hardware asset lifecycle, from receipt through disposition.
* Apply standardized asset processes consistently across field sites to strengthen data accuracy, accountability, and audit readiness.

Documentation and Best Practices

* Document best practices and policy interpretations aligned to the ServiceNow HAM environment configured for the VA.
* Develop and maintain knowledge articles and reference materials that enable field staff to complete tasks independently and consistently.
* Capture lessons learned and field insights to inform continuous improvement of processes, training, and platform configuration.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science or technical discipline is required (8 year

**Position Title** Senior SF STEM Program Manager

**Location**: San Francisco, CA

**About SMART**

SMART (Schools, Mentoring and Resource Team, Inc.) champions education equity by supporting students in overcoming systemic barriers on their journey to a college degree. We envision a community with equitable pathways to college graduation for every student in San Francisco. SMART provides a unique twelve-year continuum of support that starts in 4th grade and extends through college, including school support, after-school enrichment, summer programming, college prep, and college persistence support. As a result, SMART Scholars are more than four times more likely to graduate college when compared to their peers. Furthermore, while only 21% of low-income students who enter college will graduate within six years, SMART Scholars are currently persisting at a rate of more than 80%.

SMART’s Values:

* Community: We build a community that celebrates diversity, thrives on teamwork, and appreciates everyone’s contributions. Through community, we are stronger.
* Equity: We are committed to systems and processes that are just, fair, and inclusive, enabling all people the opportunity to belong, participate, and reach their full potential.
* Empowerment: We believe the path to empowerment and self-advocacy is through the encouragement, support, and guidance of those around us.
* Learning: We believe education and life-long learning enhance our understanding of our world, our place within it, and provide the tools to change it. Through embracing challenges and learning opportunities, we make progress.
* Joy: We center joy in our community and practice. We view joy as an act of liberation, which unleashes creativity, strengthens relationships, and propels the work that we do.

SMART has partnered with the Crankstart Foundation to launch SF STEM at SMART, a new program for SFUSD students from low-income households who demonstrate strong math aptitude. *Student and Family Advising and Activities*

Established in 1980, HomeFirst™ is a nonprofit organization passionately working to end homelessness. We serve the Bay Area community through low-barrier programming and systems leadership – meeting each person where they are by offering support and resources that address immediate and long-term housing needs. With nearly 45 years of experience, we view housing as a fundamental human right and understand that solving homelessness requires a collaborative effort.

* ***Passion****: We ignite change to fulfill our mission.*
* ***Excellence****: We deliver exceptional service to our communities.*

A Markham Plaza Case Manager is responsible for providing comprehensive support services to help individuals and families participating in permanent supportive housing programs. Their intensive and individualized case management services are coupled with linkage to a network of community resources to assist clients in averting homelessness, maintaining housing, and increasing self-sufficiency. To this end, the Housing Retention Case Manager participates in our collective effort to end and prevent homelessness.

This role reports to the Program Manager.

They manage their time well and demonstrate strong organizational abilities. With the support of program leadership, the Case Manager participates in our culture of learning and increases their knowledge of evidence-based practices over the course of their employment. Together, we model the values and principles of HomeFirst within the agency and broader community.

* Achieve identified program and position deliverables.
* Adhere to task completion deadlines.

* Attend all job-related meetings, including program staff meetings and agency-wide meetings.
* Participate in opportunities for learning and skill maintenance/development.
* Utilize supervision appropriately, maintaining open lines of communication and activity.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. Additionally, HomeFirst participates in the E-Verify program, as required by law.

-------------

At Atlas Copco, success comes from those who are curious, innovative, and committed to excellence. If you enjoy building strategic customer relationships, connecting people across regions, and turning project insight into business opportunities, you’ll feel at home here. This role is ideal for someone who combines a global perspective with practical commercial focus and enjoys working closely with business development and local sales teams.

  

**Are you our next Global Key Account Manager – Hyperscalers?**

  

The AI-Driven Super Cycle is creating growth opportunities across AI servers, AI data centers, and related infrastructure. As Global Key Account Manager – Hyperscalers within Smart Factory Electronics, you will build and own global relationships with priority accounts including NVIDIA, Google, Meta, AWS, OpenAI, and Microsoft. These companies may not always purchase our solutions directly, but their technology choices, manufacturing requirements, and investment priorities influence server manufacturers, contract manufacturers, and tier suppliers worldwide. You will connect with the people shaping these requirements, understand the manufacturing networks behind their projects, and turn that insight into opportunities for Atlas Copco’s Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Customer Centers.

  

You will report to the Global Segment Manager, Electronics and be a part of Global Marketing.

  

**Location and Customer Proximity**

This position requires you to be based in the wider San Francisco Bay Area, California, within easy reach of key Hyperscaler offices. Close customer proximity is essential, enabling frequent in-person meetings and the flexibility to visit on short notice. The role carries global account responsibility, with travel to customer teams worldwide as needed.

-------------------

Own global account relationships and align customer priorities through a coordinated global account plan, connecting account and project information across regions.

* + Introduce the Atlas Copco ecosystem of assembly solutions to key stakeholders and build their understanding of controlled tightening, enabling them to champion our solutions with their MTBs and contract manufacturers.
  + Map relevant AI infrastructure projects, key stakeholders, decision processes, timing, requirements, and potential assembly needs so Atlas Copco can engage earlier.

  + Translate project intelligence and customer requirements into actionable business leads, giving local teams visibility beyond their existing contacts and aligning priorities across regions.

  You will lead strategic global account engagement and project visibility. BDMs will develop manufacturing application opportunities and help local teams sell solution value. Customer Centers will lead local quotations, orders, and service. Together, you will connect global customer priorities with local execution.

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

* The ability to build strategic relationships with global accounts and engage the stakeholders shaping project requirements.
* The ability to understand AI infrastructure projects and connect customer requirements with manufacturing and assembly opportunities.
* A structured approach to mapping stakeholders, decision processes, project timing, and manufacturing partners.
* The ability to collaborate across regions with BDMs and Customer Centers, aligning global account priorities and supporting local business development and execution.
* The ability to explain the value of Atlas Copco’s assembly solutions, build stakeholder understanding and support, and turn global account insight into actionable business opportunities.

---------------------

Base Pay: $135K - $160K/year

OTE: $185K - $200K range

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. **About the role and team**  
  
Uber’s Global Delivery Partnerships (GDP) team manages relationships with major global brands, connecting global account strategy with execution across markets. These partnerships require close coordination across commercial teams, Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, Ads, and Direct to deliver merchant outcomes and sustainable growth.  
  
As the Manager, Global Delivery Partner Enablement Lead, you will own the enablement strategy and roadmap for GDP, building the processes, tools, and capabilities that help senior sellers and account managers lead complex partnerships effectively. As the central enablement partner to the global GDP organization, you will translate commercial priorities into consistent, practical ways of working that strengthen account strategy, improve execution, and support growth across brands and markets.  
  
You will partner with GDP leadership to identify where enablement can have the greatest impact, establish priorities, and drive adoption of shared commercial practices. Your portfolio will include joint business planning, executive business reviews, account governance, negotiation preparation, and cross-functional coordination.  
  
This role requires someone who combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution, earns credibility with experienced commercial leaders, and turns ambiguous challenges into scalable solutions. The emphasis is on embedding enablement into daily work through better processes, tools, and targeted capability development.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Own the GDP enablement strategy and roadmap:** Translate business priorities, performance insights, and account team needs into a focused portfolio of initiatives. Align GDP leadership on expected outcomes, sequencing, investment, and trade-offs.
* **Establish effective commercial practices:** Develop and embed frameworks for strategic account planning, joint business planning, stakeholder management, opportunity development, and execution tracking. Balance shared standards with flexibility for different brands, partnership structures, and market needs.
* **Elevate business reviews and executive engagement:** Build frameworks that help teams connect performance insights, merchant priorities, and growth opportunities into clear recommendations and decisions. Partner with Finance, analytics, and commercial leaders to establish consistent measures and compelling client narratives.
* **Strengthen global-to-local account governance:** Partner with GDP leaders and cross-functional teams to clarify responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths. Improve how global account strategies translate into regional and market-level commitments and execution.
* **Build tools that improve commercial effectiveness:** Lead the development of reusable proposal structures, negotiation preparation guides, opportunity assessments, account briefs, and other resources that improve the quality and efficiency of commercial work.
* **Drive commercial rigor and visibility:** Partner with Sales Operations and GDP leadership to establish useful expectations for account documentation, opportunity management, Salesforce hygiene, and follow-through. Ensure these practices support decision-making, cross-market coordination, and reliable reporting.
* **Enable complex partnership growth:** Equip teams to navigate global and local stakeholders, franchise relationships, cross-market negotiations, and opportunities spanning Delivery, Ads, and Direct. Build practical approaches that help teams connect Uber’s capabilities to partner objectives.
* **Lead adoption and continuous improvement:** Pilot new approaches with account teams, secure leadership sponsorship, and embed successful practices into existing operating rhythms. Use working sessions, targeted coaching, and peer learning to support application in live account situations.
* **Connect business changes to account execution:** Partner with Product, Operations, Policy, and other subject matter experts to translate relevant launches and changes into account planning guidance, client discussion resources, and coordinated execution plans.
* **Advance commercial productivity through technology:** Improve access to resources, insights, and expertise through approved platforms. Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to simplify account research, preparation, documentation, and knowledge discovery.
* **Scale effective practices across GDP:** Capture successful approaches from brand and regional teams, establish clear ownership for shared resources, and coordinate with global and regional Enablement partners to avoid duplication.
* **Measure impact and guide priorities:** Define success measures spanning adoption, execution quality, productivity, and relevant commercial outcomes. Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations to GDP leadership, and refine the roadmap based on evidence.

  
**Basic qualifications**

new_jobs.title: Network Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

### **Proactive Client Improvement**

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

### **Leadership**

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ year
